note: Both sets cover the same core facts (plumbing fixtures with tags, the two F10 patio side table size/quantity rows, WB profile, tile dimensions) and both repeat the F10 dimensions under two naming schemes. Set A adds two truncated/misread values — WC model 'C454CUFG#0' (page: C454CUFG#01) and PT1 description 'PORCELAIN' (page: PORCELAIN GLAZED TILE) — plus a trivial 'Bed (F1) description BED' claim. Set B's only unique error is the truncated 'Bed (F1) size 3"' (page: 3'-6" x 6'-4" x 3'-11"), while it keeps the tile style number FGEEOB412 as a condition and gives quantities for both F10 options. Both share the truncated 'Shower | location | BATHR' claim, so B ends up with fewer wrong claims.
remarks: Both sets leave the 'Option 1/Option 2' labels on the F10 rows as conditions/attributes that the page never states (the schedule simply lists two size rows); this is a shared interpretive addition. Both also share the truncated quote/value 'LOCATION: BATHR' (page: BATHROOM SHOWER) and the vague entity 'Shower' (could be SV shower valve or SH shower head). Large parts of the page are extracted by neither set: equipment models/locations (dishwasher, refrigerator, washer, dryer, cooktop, hood fan, wall oven, TV), the finish and floor-finish schedules (paint colours/numbers, tile styles, glass, laminate, VCT), and most millwork rows.
